verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a deployment/hosting platform, since self-hostable alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Netlify's managed cloud platform (global CDN, managed Postgres, hosted AI Gateway) and never mentions a self-hostable distribution of the core product. The community comment about choosing Netlify to avoid self-hosting reflects a user preference, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
